proposed.text: Which information is specifically requested from the foreign architect in the PRBoA Temporary/Special Permit application form?

options.text: Passport number and issuing country/state, plus details of the architect's professional registration
Only a notarized employment contract with the Filipino counterpart
Only a UAP chapter endorsement and project perspective drawings
Only a business permit from the local government unit

proposed.code_citation: PRBoA Resolution No. 03 s.2008, Annex A Temporary/Special Permit application form, PDF pp.14 and 16.

rationale.a: Correct. Annex A asks for the foreign architect's passport number and issuing country/state, and for registration/license details.
rationale.b: The application form is broader than an employment contract.
rationale.c: The source does not make a UAP chapter endorsement and perspective drawings the application-form answer.
rationale.d: A local business permit alone does not supply the foreign architect's professional identity and registration information.
rationale.correct: The PRBoA Temporary/Special Permit form asks for personal, passport, specialization, and professional registration details from the foreign architect, with supporting application notes.
rationale.takeaway: For TSP documentation questions, use the PRBoA form details; do not import Section 27 reciprocity-exam documents unless the question is about licensure-exam reciprocity.
